text:
Lina G: Hey team — AcmeHealth just uploaded their vendor security questionnaire and a DPA they want signed as part of onboarding. We need answers for the DPA + SOC2 vendor form by EOD Wed. Who can own the KMS/key provenance + data residency bits?
Ravi S: I can take KMS/key provenance. Do we have a clear BYOK stance for this account?
Marta L: On legal side, we just need the standard DPA template filled; if they request BYOK we escalate but usually we provide KMS metadata and attestations.
Devon P: I'll collect the residency / processing locations. Quick Q: will embeddings be stored long-term for this customer? (affects retention answers)
Lina G: They indicated embeddings for search will be retained, TTL unknown. Jordan (acct) wrote: "we plan to keep indexes for 90 days" in the intake email.
onboarding-bot: New intake created: https://redwood.example.com/intakes/ACME-3311 — form attached (acme_vendor_questionnaire.pdf) :paperclip:
Ravi S: OK i'll draft the KMS answer. Proposed snippet: `Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS integrations; for hosted customers we can also provide attestation of key provenance and rotation policy.` Putting it in a doc and sharing.
Marta L: Add the SOC2 control references for encryption: CC6.1 and CC7.2 are usually sufficient. I'll add legal-approved wording: `We do not hold private keys unless customer elects Redwood-managed keys.`
Devon P: For residency: confirm processing region is us-west-2 and backups replicated in us-east-1 only. I'll verify with infra and paste the config lines.
Lina G: To keep this tidy, quick checklist — can we follow this and react with :white_check_mark: when done?
```
DPA intake checklist
- KMS / key provenance (owner: Ravi)
- Data residency & replication (owner: Devon)
- Retention period for embeddings (owner: Lina / Customer)
- SOC2 control references (owner: Marta)
- Upload final filled form to intake portal (owner: Lina)
```
Ravi S: ✅ started drafting KMS answer, will ping security for rotation table.
Devon P: Pinged infra; they confirm primary region us-west-2, backups us-east-1. Adding config: `processing_regions: [us-west-2] replication: [us-east-1]`
Marta L: Draft ready, sending to Lina for final review. Suggested redlines in doc.
Lina G: Great — I'll upload the completed form to the intake link by EOD Wed and flag for legal signature. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Ravi S: If customer insists on BYOK we need 72h notice to provision key-handoff docs — note for onboarding timeline.
Devon P: Noted. Adding to onboarding checklist in Confluence.
Lina G: Closing loop here — will post the uploaded file and final timestamp in this thread when done.
